# Instructions for accurately documenting results that contradict the hypothesis in a psychology research report

1. Start with the research records.

completion:
Carefully read the methodological section where methodological limitations and shortcomings are reported.
3. Start with the limitations stated in the manuscript and put all of them  in the section with results/discussion.

These instructions for accurately documenting results that contradict the hypothesis were developed by the [European Journal of Social Psychology](http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/journal/00462772).

These instructions are based on the [reproducibility movement](http://reproduce.io). To go [replicate this analysis](http://reproduce.io/roots/) follow this [link](http://reproduce.io/roots/).
